script.title: Quiz: Bored or boring?

lines.text: A: I'm boring in class. B: I'm bored in class. Three, two, one!
It's B! I'm bored is how you feel. I'm boring means I'm no fun.
Exactly! The class was boring, so I was bored.
Kit's tip: bored is how you feel. Boring is what makes you feel that way.
